done_when: forge test --pytest treats a lockfile change that only moves the repo's own package version (uv.lock, poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock or package-lock.json) as not a shared test input, and still runs the full suite for any dependency change; a command test shows a version-only lockfile change selecting only related tests and a dependency change running everything; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each
why: Every version bump re-runs the whole test suite twice locally (40 min in the worker, 25+ min in close) because any lockfile change counts as a shared test input, though a bump only moves the project's own version
